==English==
{{wp|<dab>}}
[[File:Notice of Baggage Inspection issued by the Transportation Security Administration, USA - 20130920.jpg|thumb|upright|A Notice of Baggage Inspection issued by the {{w|Transportation Security Administration}} of the USA which was placed inside a piece of [[luggage]] after it had been searched]]

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|not.||abbreviation}}

===Etymology===
Borrowed from {{bor|en|frm|notice}}, from the {{der|en|la|nōtitia}}. {{doublet|en|notitia}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈnəʊ.tɪs/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈnoʊ.tɪs/|[ˈnoʊ.ɾɪs]|a=GenAm,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-notice.ogg|a=California}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈnəʉ.tɪs/|[ˈnəʉ.ɾɪs]|[ˈnɐʉ.tɪs]|[ˈnɐʉ.ɾɪs]|a=AU|q3=some speakers|q4=some speakers}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈnɐʉ.təs/|[ˈnɐʉ.ɾəs]|a=NZ}}
* {{IPA|en|a=Indic|/ˈno.ʈɪs/}}
* {{hyphenation|en|no|tice}}
* {{rhymes|en|əʊtɪs}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|mostly|uncountable}} The act of [[observing]]; [[perception]].
#: {{ux|en|He took no '''notice''' of the changes, and went on as though nothing had happened.}}
#* {{RQ:Besant Ivory Gate|chapter=Prologue|page=16|passage=Athelstan Arundel walked home{{nb...}}, foaming and raging. {{...}} He walked the whole way, walking through crowds, and under the noses of dray-horses, carriage-horses, and cart-horses, without taking the least '''notice''' of them.}}
#* {{RQ:Watts Improvement
|passage=How ready is envy to mingle with the '''notices''' which we take of other persons?}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[written]] or [[printed]] [[announcement]].
#: {{ux|en|A series of '''notice'''s signpost patients to the X-ray department.}}
#: {{ux|en|A '''notice''' was attached to the building reminding the residents about the five hour water shortage that was happening today.}}
#: {{ux|en|I always read the death '''notices''' in the paper.}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[formal]] [[notification]] or [[warning]].
#: {{ux|en|The sidewalk adjacent to the damaged bridge stonework shall be closed until further '''notice'''.}}
# {{senseid|en|notice of termination of employment}} {{lb|en|chiefly|uncountable}} [[advance|Advance]] [[notification]] of [[termination]] of [[employment]], given by an employer to an employee or vice versa.
#: {{ux|en|I gave her her mandatory two weeks' '''notice''' and sacked her.}}
#: {{ux|en|I can't work here any longer. I'm giving '''notice'''.}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[publish]]ed [[critical]] [[review]] of a [[play]] or the like.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1989|title=The New York Times Theater Reviews, 1920-|volume=18|page=167
|passage=The first-night audience, yes. The first-night reviewers, not exactly. The '''notices''' have so far been mixed, only The Financial Times having delivered itself of an unequivocal rave.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} [[prior|Prior]] [[notification]].
#: {{ux|en|I don't mind if you want to change the venue; just give me some '''notice''' first, OK?}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare King Lear|act=II|scene=i|passage=I have been with your father and given him '''notice''' that the Duke of Cornwall and Regan his duchess will be here with him this night.}}
# {{lb|en|dated}} Attention; respectful treatment; civility.

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|now|rare}} To [[remark]] upon; to [[mention]]. {{defdate|from 17th c.}}
#* {{RQ:Wollstonecraft Vindication Women|passage=Numberless are the arguments {{...}} that men have used morally and physically, to degrade the sex. I must '''notice''' a few.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To become aware of; to [[observe]]. {{defdate|from 17th c.}}
#: {{ux|en|Did you '''notice''' the flowers in her yard?}}
#* {{quote-av|en|year=1991|author=w:Gregory Widen|title=[[w:Backdraft (film)|Backdraft]]
|passage=So you punched out a window for ventilation. Was that ''before'' or ''after'' you '''noticed''' you were standing in a lake of gasoline?}}
#* {{quote-journal
|en
|date=August 5, 2012
|author=Nathan Rabin
|work=w:A.V. Club
|title=TV: Review: THE SIMPSONS (CLASSIC): “I Love Lisa” (season 4, episode 15; originally aired 02/11/1993)
|url=http://www.avclub.com/articles/i-love-lisa,83183/
|page=
|passage=Valentine’s Day means different things for different people. For Homer, it means forking over a hundred dollars for a dusty box of chocolates at the Kwik-E-Mart after characteristically forgetting the holiday yet again. For Ned, it’s another opportunity to prove his love for his wife. Most germane to the episode, for Lisa, Valentine’s Day means being the only person in her entire class to give Ralph a Valentine after '''noticing''' him looking crestfallen and alone at his desk.
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130329115214/http://www.avclub.com/articles/i-love-lisa,83183/}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-07-20|volume=408|issue=8845
|url=http://www.economist.com/news/science-and-technology/21581981-what-pollution-some-opportunity-others-welcome-plastisphere|title=Welcome to the plastisphere
|passage=[The researchers] '''noticed''' many of their pieces of [plastic marine] debris sported surface pits around two microns across. Such pits are about the size of a bacterial cell. Closer examination showed that some of these pits did, indeed, contain bacteria, […].|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170711074435/https://www.economist.com/news/science-and-technology/21581981-what-pollution-some-opportunity-others-welcome-plastisphere|archivedate=11 July 2017}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete|transitive}} To lavish attention upon; to treat (someone) favourably. {{defdate|17th–19th c.}}
#* {{RQ:Austen Emma|I|3|text=She would '''notice''' her; she would improve her; she would detach her from her bad acquaintance, and introduce her into good society; she would form her opinions and her manners.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To be [[noticeable]]; to [[show]]. {{defdate|from 20th c.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1954|author=w:Barbara Comyns|title=Who Was Changed And Who Was Dead|publisher=Dorothy|year_published=2010|page=9
|passage=The blackness didn't '''notice''' so much when she was born; but it's unmistakeable now.}}
# {{senseid|en|anti-Semitism}} {{C|en|Antisemitism|Alt-right}} {{lb|en|intransitive|internet slang|conspiracy theory|religious slur}} To [[perceive]] {{w|international Jewish conspiracy|Jewish influence or responsibility}}.
#: {{alti|en|nootice|notice patterns}}
#: {{coord|en|pattern noticer}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Noticing''' is [[antiseptic]].}}
